automaticBidExplanation: We’ll bid automatically only as needed, up to your maximum.
automaticBidHoldExplanation: Your card hold covers the maximum. You may pay less if the auction ends below it.
maximumMechanismSubtext: We bid only as needed up to your maximum. Hold matches it; you can raise, not lower or cancel.
privateMaximumTooltip: Your maximum is the most you are willing to pay before buyer fees. Other bidders cannot see it. We only bid as needed to keep you leading.
automaticMaximumConfirmed: Your maximum of {amount} is set. Your card hold covers the maximum, and you may pay less if the auction ends below it.
autoExtendedTooltip: A bid in the last {windowMinutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} adds {durationMinutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} to the close. Repeats until {durationMinutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} pass with no bids, up to the listing cap.
bindingBid: Binding bid. You commit to buy at {amount} if you win.
buyerFeeHint: Buyer fee is added on top of the winning bid
buyerFeeTooltip: Winners pay a percentage of the hammer price as a buyer fee. The rate is confirmed at checkout.
extendedBiddingRules: If a bid is placed during the final {windowMinutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}, the auction extends by {durationMinutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. Extensions continue until no bid is placed in the final window.
payInvoiceHint: Please pay your invoice to complete this purchase.
recentSalesEmpty: Recent sales for this lot are not available yet.
